adoptedInstance.rootCause: JSONL replay and event parsing were applied to a native file; original path equality had already passed. No native adoption product defect was demonstrated.
adoptedInstance.nativeContract: Three real public agents share the project, resume the source session by ID, stop and replace its history across differing creation-clock timestamps, restart on its original path, continue public provider turns, reopen independently, preserve exact committed rows, original start facts/session identity, and a single listing. Native observations use indexed read-only committed row trees and session facts, not whole-file binary reads.
